# Bin Rasool Enterprises

> Direct OEM and Private Label Sportswear, Activewear, Heavyweight Streetwear & Combat Gear Manufacturer based in Sialkot, Pakistan.

## Factory Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Bin Rasool Enterprises (Pvt) Ltd
- **Location**: Pakki Kotli, Daska Road, Sialkot 51310, Punjab, Pakistan
- **Core Specialty**: Custom OEM/ODM apparel manufacturing, private label branding, and global B2B export.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: 50 pieces per style/colorway across standard size ranges (XS–3XL).
- **Sample Turnaround Time**: 7 to 10 business days (Dispatched worldwide via DHL Express with tracking).
- **Bulk Production Lead Time**: 3 to 4 weeks post-sample approval.
- **In-House Capabilities**: CAD pattern grading, automated cutting, 4-needle 6-thread flatlock stitching, digital sublimation, silk screen printing, 3D silicone heat transfers, puff embroidery, 50D damask woven labels, custom frosted EVA zipper polybags.
- **Export Markets**: USA, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, South Africa, Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, and UAE.
- **Incoterms**: FOB Karachi, Ex-Factory Sialkot, DDP Express Air Cargo (DHL / FedEx Priority), Ocean Container Freight.
- **Contact & Inquiries**: sales@binrasoolenterprises.com | info@binrasoolenterprises.com
- **Direct Phone / WhatsApp**: +92 313 3599241
- **Official Website**: https://binrasoolenterprises.com

## Product Divisions & Manufacturing Plants

- [Activewear & Fitness Plant](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/fitness-wear-manufacturer): Custom activewear, gym leggings, sports bras, seamless sets, and athleisure with 4-way stretch interlock and flatlock stitching.
- [Heavyweight Hoodies & Streetwear](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/hoodies-manufacturer): 450–500 GSM heavyweight French Terry hoodies, oversized boxy fits, puff screen printing, vintage acid/pigment wash, and custom metal aglets.
- [Boxing & Combat Gear Workshop](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/boxing-gear-manufacturer): Genuine cowhide leather boxing gloves, sparring headguards, pro fight gloves with multi-layer EVA and IMF foam padding.
- [Boxing Apparel & Fight Wear](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/boxing-wear-manufacturer): Heavyweight satin fight shorts, entrance robes, corner vests, and walkout tracksuits.
- [Martial Arts, BJJ Gis & Rashguards](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/mma-gear): 350–550 GSM preshrunk Pearl Weave cotton BJJ Gis, IBJJF-compliant cut, ripstop pants, and sublimated poly-spandex rashguards.
- [Custom Tracksuits & Warmups](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/sportswear-manufacturer): Poly-tricot and micro-taslan nylon matching 2-piece tracksuits, fleece warmups, custom piping, and YKK hardware.
- [Sublimated Teamwear & Sports Uniforms](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/sportswear-manufacturer): Italian fade-proof digital sublimation, breathable birdseye mesh, soccer kits, basketball uniforms, and full roster customization.
- [Performance Compression & Baselayers](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/compression-wear): High-spandex power knit (80/20 & 75/25 Nylon-Spandex), thermal brushed backing, anti-chafing flatlock seams.
- [Custom Denim & Jeans](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/jeans-manufacturer): 11–14oz ring-spun selvedge, raw indigo, enzyme stone wash, laser whiskers, leather back patches, and brass rivets.
- [Streetwear & Outerwear Jackets](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/streetwear-manufacturer): Melton wool varsity jackets, genuine leather sleeves, chenille embroidery patches, windbreakers, and puffer jackets.
- [Private Label Packaging & Trims](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-manufacturing): 50D damask woven neck labels, 400 GSM foil-stamped hang tags, frosted EVA zipper polybags, and scannable Amazon FBA barcodes.

## Regional Export Programs

- [USA Private Label Sourcing](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-usa): American sizing blocks (XS to 5XL), ASTM seam burst standards, FTC-compliant satin labels, and express DDP air cargo to all 50 states.
- [UK Clothing Brands Export](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-uk): Direct air freight into London Heathrow & Manchester, UK metric grading, OEKO-TEX certified reactive dyes, and EUR1/REX documentation.
- [South Africa Activewear & Rugby](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-south-africa): SABS athletic sizing, UPF 50+ sun protection, high-tensile rugby uniforms, air cargo to OR Tambo (JNB) & Cape Town (CPT), and sea freight to Durban port.
- [Australia & NZ Activewear Sourcing](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-australia): UPF 50+ UV protection knits, lightweight moisture-wicking fabrics, Sydney/Melbourne air freight, and GST entry handling.
- [Germany Sportbekleidung](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-germany): DIN dimensional stability, Frankfurt hub customs clearance, and Azo-free OEKO-TEX dyes.
- [France Vêtements de Sport](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-france): French couture activewear, luxury trims, Paris CDG express air freight.
- [Netherlands Activewear Hub](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-netherlands): Amsterdam Schiphol gateway, Rotterdam maritime freight, and Northern European tall-fit grading.
- [Italy Sportswear & Fight Gear](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-italy): Milan Malpensa express air transit, Italian sublimation inks, and ergonomic tailoring.
- [Spain Ropa Deportiva](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-spain): High-airflow mesh, padel & fitness uniforms, Madrid/Barcelona air transit.
- [European Union Export Program](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/private-label-activewear-manufacturer-europe): EU REACH chemical compliance, multi-language care labeling, and express courier door-to-door.
- [Startup & Emerging Brands Launchpad](https://binrasoolenterprises.com/activewear-manufacturer-for-startups): 50 pcs flexible split-size opening orders, complete tech pack assistance, and full private label trims from drop one.
